af7431a3964d: The algorithm makes repeated passes over the list. In each pass, it compares each item with its neighbor and swaps them if they are not in the required order. The largest unsorted item rises to the end of the list in each pass, and the algorithm stops when a full pass makes no swaps.
861d61091a07: It searches the unsorted part for the smallest item (or the largest in descending order), then places it in the first unsorted position with at most one swap.
757e1da82c07: Each item is taken and inserted at its position within the sorted part on its left, shifting the items that come after it in the order one step to the right.
8581debd11ce: The list is repeatedly split into two halves until each part is a single item, then every two sorted parts are merged into a larger sorted part.
